namedCards.notes: Table-state gate for the Maul setup deploy, not a Dark-side pull target.

namedCards.notes: Broad pull filter. 221_19 is the named First Light sample; non-unique blasters remain runtime-filtered.

locationRequirements.label: Two battlegrounds controlled by gangsters
locationRequirements.text: Flip during your battle phase if your gangsters control two battlegrounds

locationRequirements.label: Three occupied battlegrounds
locationRequirements.text: Opponent loses 1 Force when this card flips and you occupy three battlegrounds

characterRequirements.label: Maul
characterRequirements.text: If Massassi Throne Room on table, may deploy Maul to Maul's Chambers at setup. Back side may peek at Force Pile if Maul is alone.

characterRequirements.label: Gangster
characterRequirements.text: Gangsters controlling two battlegrounds can flip the objective during your battle phase.

characterRequirements.label: Gangster leader
characterRequirements.text: Back side can add one destiny to total power if your gangster leader is in battle at same site as your non-unique blaster.

target.label: non-unique blaster or First Light title card

entries.flip: Front -> back if you just hit a character, or during your battle phase if your gangsters control two battlegrounds. Java: TriggerConditions.justHitBy(Filters.character, Filters.your(playerId)) OR GameConditions.controlsWith(playerId, 2, Filters.battleground, Filters.gangster).
entries.flipBack: Back -> front at end of each turn. The front-side cardFlipped trigger applies the occupy-three-battlegrounds Force-loss rider when the card flips.
entries.hardLose: None. No place-out-of-play condition in front or back Java.

locationRequirements.label: Scarif battleground
locationRequirements.text: Once per turn, may deploy a Scarif battleground from Reserve Deck

locationRequirements.label: Scarif battleground site
locationRequirements.text: Flip and flip-back character presence gate

locationRequirements.label: Death Star orbiting Scarif
locationRequirements.text: Flip requires Death Star system orbiting Scarif

characterRequirements.text: Front flips if Krennic or Tarkin is at a Scarif battleground site while Death Star orbits Scarif.

characterRequirements.label: Your leader at Scarif battleground site
characterRequirements.text: Back flips to front if you do not have a leader at a Scarif battleground site.

characterRequirements.label: Vader
characterRequirements.text: Back side lets Vader make a regular move to a battle just initiated.

entries.hardLose: Back places objective out of play if no Death Star system is on table or Shield Gate is not on table.

namedCards.notes: Title siblings include 3_149 DARK and 3_62 LIGHT, but setup pull is Icon.VIRTUAL_SET_17 gated.

namedCards.label: 1st Marker / Main Power Generators
namedCards.runtimeFilter: Filters.First_Marker for setup, Filters.title(Title.Main_Power_Generators, true) for flip
namedCards.notes: Light title siblings 3_61 and 210_15 exist; Java flip target is title based.

namedCards.label: [Set 9] Prepare For A Surface Attack
namedCards.notes: Base title sibling 13_82 exists, but setup pull is Icon.VIRTUAL_SET_9 gated.

namedCards.label: Target The Main Generator
namedCards.notes: Not pulled by objective Java directly, but live ObjectiveAnalyzer V160 treats it as required/pullable flip-engine card.

namedCards.label: AT-AT Cannon
namedCards.notes: V160 ObjectiveAnalyzer pullable card; front Java also prevents your AT-AT cannons from firing during your control phase.

namedCards.label: Sunsdown
namedCards.notes: Filters.Sunsdown is title exact for 1_230; combo id 10_50 is included as seed caveat and should be checked before treating combos as exact title filters.

namedCards.label: Rebel Leadership
namedCards.notes: Back Java uses title("Rebel Leadership") OR Were_Doomed. Combo id 218_5 is a seed caveat, not guaranteed by exact title filter.

namedCards.label: We're Doomed
namedCards.notes: Filters.Were_Doomed is title exact for 1_120; combo id 204_18 is included as seed caveat and should be checked before treating combos as exact title filters.

locationRequirements.label: Hoth location
locationRequirements.text: Once per turn may deploy a Hoth location from Reserve Deck

locationRequirements.label: Main Power Generators
locationRequirements.text: Front flips when Main Power Generators is blown away

locationRequirements.label: Occupied Hoth site
locationRequirements.text: Back stays in play only if you occupy a Hoth site with a piloted AT-AT, Imperial leader, or snowtrooper
locationRequirements.runtimeFilter: Filters.and(Filters.Hoth_site, Filters.occupiesWith(playerId, self, Filters.or(Filters.and(Filters.AT_AT, Filters.piloted), Filters.Imperial_leader, Filters.snowtrooper)))

characterRequirements.label: Snowtrooper
characterRequirements.text: Back side can deploy a snowtrooper from Reserve Deck and a snowtrooper can satisfy the Hoth-site occupation hard-lose guard.

characterRequirements.label: Imperial leader
characterRequirements.text: Back side adds attrition against opponent for each Imperial leader in battle and accepts Imperial leader for Hoth-site occupation guard.

characterRequirements.label: Piloted AT-AT
characterRequirements.text: Back side accepts piloted AT-AT for Hoth-site occupation guard.
characterRequirements.notes: Vehicle/model requirement stored here because the shard shape has no VehicleRequirement array.

characterRequirements.label: Dark Jedi except Vader
characterRequirements.text: Front Java prevents deploying Dark Jedi except Vader for remainder of game.

target.runtimeFilter: Filters.bottomOfLostPile(playerId) OR top X opponent Reserve where X = countTopLocationsOnTable(Filters.and(Filters.Hoth_location, Filters.controls(playerId)))
target.label: bottom Lost Pile card or opponent Reserve top X

entries.flip: Front -> back when Main Power Generators is blown away. Java: TriggerConditions.isBlownAwayLastStep(..., Filters.title(Title.Main_Power_Generators, true)).
entries.flipBack: None. Back side has no FlipCardEffect back to front.
entries.hardLose: Back places objective out of play if you do not occupy a Hoth site with a piloted AT-AT, Imperial leader, or snowtrooper.
